_why: Attested extract, not page bytes. There is no automation channel to a browser in this runtime (APP-54: Playwright absent, npm egress 403, no browser tool, Brave without --remote-debugging-port), so the agent that parses a listing cannot fetch one. QA captured the real page on APP-156; `upstream_sha256` is the hash of the bytes QA received, NOT a hash of anything reconstructed here. The raw artifact is attached to APP-156 and is deliberately not duplicated into this repo.
declared_freshness: Ratings are updated daily and may not reflect the most recent reviews.
scope_note: QA scoped extraction to the item's own block. The page also rendered 4.5, 4.6 and 4.2 for RECOMMENDED extensions, which are NOT json-workbench's.
_refused_why: The listing's `3 users` is the public-listing surface, not the dashboard's Weekly Users page. The two disagreed for json-workbench (5 on 2026-09-27 dashboard vs 3 on 2026-09-28 listing). Mapping it to cws_weekly_users would answer the open APP-54 question with the wrong instrument. Recorded here only so it is not rediscovered later as fresh evidence.
